content:
Moonlight spills on quiet stone,  
A silver hush the night has known.  
The wind leans soft through sleeping trees,  
And carries dreams on wandering breeze.

A window glows, a candle sighs,  
One star hangs low in velvet skies.  
The world, for now, grows small and mild—  
Darkness gentles, tender, wild.

So if your heart feels far from home,  
Remember: night does not roam alone.  
It keeps a thousand hidden sparks  
To light us softly through the dark.
